name: workspaces
description: Teaches agents that isolated per-agent checkouts exist in jj-colocated repos via `jjx` (jj's equivalent of a git worktree), and how to drive it: `jjx open <slug>` creates or idempotently resumes a managed sibling workspace and prints its path on stdout, `--from <revset>` bases it on an explicit revision instead of the caller's uncommitted state, `jjx open --unique <slug>` forces a fresh workspace for fan-out, `jjx add <path>` adds an existing checkout at an explicit path, and `jjx rm <path>` cleans up without discarding unsaved work. The single skill exists to be found by the failure it prevents — an agent about to conclude that parallel isolated work isn't possible in a jj repo, or reaching for a plain git worktree instead.
